name: My Liege
storyline:
As lord of the smallest noble house sworn to your Liege, you must lead your people and family through turmoil. In this choose your own adventure RPG, can you grow your influence while keeping neighbors from taking over thy lands? Pick everything from house name, sigil, and commands for your house!

Your Liege Lord needs you! As the days grow shorter, your house and that of your neighbors grow restless. Can you afford to share food with your Liege Lord's house, proving your allegiance? Or will your people starve in the coming winter? Will your house guard help defend the kingdom, or will your most trusted men stay at your side?
summary: My Liege is a medieval RPG that plays like a choose your own adventure visual novel. Unlike most medieval stories however, the house you are Lord of is the smallest and least influential of the noble houses. It is up to you to make the best of tough situations if your house is to maintain its place in the noble hierarchy.
